_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja CargoHold/Ladownia (85 terminow, ~18 mikroscen) - obszar nalezacy do postaci okreslanej w zrodle jako 'Mariana' (namiot, fajka, dyktafon) - prawdopodobnie NPC/pasazerka niebedaca jednym z 8 glownych podejrzanych, ale watek nie jest jednoznacznie potwierdzony w tym batchu.
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci. Postac 'Mariana' (wlascicielka namiotu/fajki/dyktafonu) uzyta jako etykieta mowcy dla jej bezposrednich kwestii (Tent1/ds1-2) - tozsamosc niepotwierdzona, patrz VERIFICATION_QUEUE.

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_BG/Section d.en: It's made entirely out of wood...
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_BG/Section d.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBox2/S.en: Normally when we complete a puzzle... something unlocks and we get a new clue.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBox2/S.pl: Zazwyczaj, gdy rozwiążemy zagadkę... coś się odblokowuje i dostajemy nowy trop.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBox2/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBox2/S.en: Yeah, we've been conditioned to expect it.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBox2/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBox2/S.en: If it's a clue you want...
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBox2/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBox2/S.en: Take a look on the back of the pin board.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBox2/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBoxNot.en: I assume it belongs to that woman over there.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBoxNot.pl: Zakładam, że należy do tej kobiety tam.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBoxNot.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBoxNot.en:
Right.
We'd better talk to her first.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBoxNot.pl:
No tak.
Lepiej najpierw z nią porozmawiajmy.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_LockedBoxNot.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Map/Section.en: There's something in the pouch I think we should take a look at.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Map/Section.pl: Jest coś w tej torbie, na co powinniśmy spojrzeć.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Map/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Pipe/Section.en: Let's take a look at Mariana's pipe...
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Pipe/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent1/Sectio.en: I [i]enjoy[/i] that she called you bucko.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent1/Sectio.pl: [i]Podoba[/i] mi się, że nazwała cię koleżką.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent1/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent1/Sectio.en: It's a piece of fabric draped over a rope.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent1/Sectio.pl: To kawałek materiału zarzucony na linę.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent1/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent2/Sectio.en: It's Mariana's tent - and she's not here to stop us looking inside.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent2/Sectio.pl: To namiot Mariany - a jej tu nie ma, żeby powstrzymać nas przed zajrzeniem do środka.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent2/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent2/Sectio.en: So... is there anything in there?
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent2/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent3/Sectio.en: Uh - it's a little plastic thing.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent3/Sectio.pl: Yy - to jakaś mała plastikowa rzecz.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent3/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent3/Sectio.en: Oh, wait - I know what this is...
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent3/Sectio.pl: Och, czekaj - wiem, co to jest...
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_Tent3/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_barrels/Sect.en: [i]Ohh,[/i] they must be full of something heavy.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_barrels/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_boxes/Sectio.en:
I... don't know.
I can't get them open.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_boxes/Sectio.pl:
Ja... nie wiem.
Nie mogę ich otworzyć.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_boxes/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_boxes/Sectio.en: What's in these old wooden crates?
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_boxes/Sectio.pl: Co jest w tych starych drewnianych skrzyniach?
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_boxes/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_coalsoil/Sec.en:
I thought it was coal.
You know - for the furnace.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_coalsoil/Sec.pl:
Myślałem, że to węgiel.
No wiesz - do pieca.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_coalsoil/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_furnace/Sect.en:
No. It's a furnace.
For [i]heating the submarine.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_furnace/Sect.pl:
Nie. To piec.
Do [i]ogrzewania łodzi podwodnej.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_furnace/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_furnace/Sect.en: But you [h]could[/h] put a pizza in there.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_furnace/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_lantern/Sect.en:
A submarine can't burn down.
It's underwater!
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_lantern/Sect.pl:
Łódź podwodna nie może się spalić.
Jest pod wodą!
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_lantern/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_lantern/Sect.en:
That's a fire hazard.
This whole room is a fire hazard...
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_lantern/Sect.pl:
To zagrożenie pożarowe.
Cały ten pokój to zagrożenie pożarowe...
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_lantern/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_laundry/Sect.en: Assuming you want your clothes to smell like the cargo hold of a submarine.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_laundry/Sect.pl: Zakładając, że chcesz, żeby twoje ubrania pachniały jak ładownia łodzi podwodnej.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_laundry/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_laundry/Sect.en: This is actually a pretty good place to hang laundry...
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_laundry/Sect.pl: To właściwie całkiem dobre miejsce do wieszania prania...
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_laundry/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_mirror/Secti.en: It could do with a polish...
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_mirror/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_tea/Section.en:
It's unfiltered, too.
And there's no milk.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_tea/Section.pl:
Jest też niefiltrowana.
I nie ma mleka.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_tea/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_tea/Section.en: I assumed it was tea, but actually it smells like coffee.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_tea/Section.pl: Zakładałem, że to herbata, ale właściwie pachnie jak kawa.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_tea/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_twigs/Sectio.en:
Ooh - maybe it's a dowsing rod.
You know, for finding water!
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_twigs/Sectio.pl:
Ooo - może to różdżka radiestezyjna.
No wiesz, do szukania wody!
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_twigs/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_twigs/Sectio.en: There's a twig on the floor.
Examine/Exam_Area_CargoHold_twigs/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire
